messages:
maria_support: Hey team — ACME reported an embeddings regression after yesterday's frozen release. They say embeddings used to be length 2048 and are now coming back as 1024. Customer says they didn't change their client code.
maria_support: Repro steps from customer: 1) call POST /v1/embeddings with model=embed-latest 2) check length of response.embedding array 3) observed 1024 instead of 2048. Sending request/response below.
maria_support: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDBOX' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-latest","input":"hello world"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
# -> 1024
```
maria_support: Full response snippet:
```json
{"object":"embedding","embedding":[0.0012, -0.0007, ... /* 1024 floats */ ], "model":"embed-latest", "model_resolved":"redwood-embed-1024-quant"}
```
maria_support: Customer wants urgent rollback or mitigation — their search index expects 2048 dims and ingestion is failing.
tony_engineering: Ack, thanks. Quick Q: was the customer using an explicit model name or an alias? If they used `embed-latest` that alias was remapped in the freeze last night.
ton y_engineering: If they pinned to a specific model (e.g. `redwood-embed-2048:v1`) they should be fine, but alias remap can change output dims.
maria_support: They were using the alias `embed-latest` (customer said they rely on alias for upgrades). They only noticed after the freeze.
jen_ml: I see a mapping change in catalog: `embed-latest` -> `redwood-embed-1024-quant` as of 2026-03-08T14:05Z. That variant uses a different embedding head (and a quantized kernel) which reduces output dimension.
deploy-bot: alias-update: "embed-latest" -> "redwood-embed-1024-quant" by ops@release-bot at 2026-03-08T14:05:12Z
maria_support: Ugh. Customer didn't expect a dim change. Can we provide a compatibility alias or auto-pad? They need to reindex but want temporary stopgap.
jen_ml: Padding is risky (semantically different). Short-term options: 1) Repoint alias to previous model while we investigate, 2) Serve a compatibility wrapper that upscales (not recommended), 3) Ask customer to pin to the explicit 2048 model.
tony_engineering: Operationally easiest is to rollback alias for accounts flagged as sensitive. I can do a scoped alias override for Acme's org id. Will need approval from oncall.
maria_support: Acme is high-priority. I'll ask CS to authorize rollback. Meanwhile can you add a fast check to our ingest pipeline to reject mismatched dims with a clear error instead of silent failures? Customer reported silent index corruption.
tony_engineering: Good call. I'll push a quick validation in the embeddings ingestion lambda that checks length against account metadata. Small PR and hotfix.
jen_ml: Also checking commit history — diff shows we swapped model build artifacts to a smaller architecture for cost reasons; metadata doc did not flag the `output_dim` change in the alias remap. Need a guard in release checklist.
maria_support: Customer asked for repro steps we can give them to validate before we flip alias back. Suggest this curl and a small python snippet.
jen_ml: Suggested python snippet for validation:
```python
import requests
r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer TOKEN'}, json={'model':'embed-latest','input':'test'})
print(len(r.json()['data'][0]['embedding']))
```
maria_support: I'll send that to the customer. Also cc'ing them that we may create a temporary org-scoped alias override.
deploy-bot: rollout-note: scoped-alias-override created for org=acme-corp, alias=embed-latest -> redwood-embed-2048:v1 (temp) by tony_engineering at 2026-03-08T14:28:03Z
tony_engineering: Done. Scoped override applied. Acme should see 2048 immediately; give them a heads-up to re-ingest any vectors created since 14:05Z.
maria_support: Noted. I'll escalate in the CS thread and offer to coordinate a reindex window.
jen_ml: Follow-ups: 1) Add `output_dim` to alias change diff and block alias remap if dimension changes and alias is used by orgs with pin-protection flag. 2) Add a release-notes field for embedding dimension changes.
maria_support: Thanks everyone — I'll update ticket and confirm with Acme once they verify. :thumbsup:
